finding_match.title_contains: default security groups should not allow inbound or outbound traffic

remediation.summary: Remove all inbound and outbound rules from the VPC default security group.

potential_side_effects: Connectivity loss for resources relying on the default security group
Disruption of workloads using the default security group for inbound communication
Disruption of workloads using the default security group for outbound communication

preconditions: Refresh the live Security Hub finding before generating a proposal.
Inspect the current inbound and outbound security group rules.
Identify current and potential dependencies on the default security group.
Identify the approved management mechanism for the resource.
Obtain explicit approval through the applicable change management process before execution.

checks: Confirm that the security group has no inbound rules.
Confirm that the security group has no outbound rules.
Confirm that Security Hub EC2.2 is PASSED after reassessment.

rollback.strategy: Restore the previously documented and approved inbound and outbound rules.
